## Service
- TradeCall System ($1,997): Custom website with local schema, AEO content, lead capture, AI phone answering with bilingual voice agents, missed-call text-back recovery, and automated lead scoring — all in one fixed-price build. 2–3 week turnaround.

## Key Facts
- Single fixed price of $1,997. No mandatory retainers. The client owns the code, domain, hosting, and data at handoff.
- Standard builds complete in 2–3 weeks from signed scope to live deployment.
- Stack: Next.js + HTML/CSS/JS, deployed on Vercel or Netlify. Full code access and handoff docs. No proprietary lock-in.
